key_reasoning.reason: Touches four components: a new shared diff helper (build_change_attributes) plus the change_audit field-set/builder module in the activity package, and the call sites in BudgetService, ProjectBudgetService (group create/update/delete, project budget update) and ProjectService (project update and a second update path). A new reusable audit abstraction is shared across the project_management and budget_management domains. All of it lives in the service layer, so it stays at L, not XL.
8 files changed per diffstat (6 source, 2 test), 412 insertions across src/codemie/service/{activity,budget,project} and tests/codemie/service/budget. Actual-mode mapping 7-10 files = L.

The activity-event emission pattern already exists (BudgetManagementEvent and the updated_fields logging used in cost_center_service). The closest pattern only lists field names and does not cover splitting fields into value fields and name-only fields to keep emails and free text out of audit payloads, so that gap bumped the score from S to M. The no-op skip and the category/total_amount diffing are new logic, but they are not security-critical and are easy to reverse.

The AC are explicit: previous_/new_ values for non-sensitive fields, name-only reporting for emails and free text, the missing group-deleted and group-updated events, and skipping events on no-op updates. No open design decisions remain.
